description: Vulnerability in the Helidon product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: helidon-webserver-static-content).  Supported versions that are affected are 3.0.0-3.2.22, 4.0.0-4.5.6 and 27.0.0-27.0.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Helidon.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS) of Helidon. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 3.7 (Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L).
